title.zh: 卷三十五 志第十五: 天文上
title.raw: 卷三十五 志第十五: 天文上 Volume 35 Treatises 15: Astronomy 1

sentences.zh: 《易》曰：「觀乎天文以察時變。」

translations.literal: The Changes says: "Observe the patterns of heaven to discern the changes of the seasons."
translations.idiomatic: The Changes says: "Observe the patterns of heaven to discern the changes of the seasons."

sentences.zh: 是故古之哲王，法垂象以施化，考庶徵以致理，以授人時，以考物紀，修其德以順其度，改其過以慎其災，去危而就安，轉禍而為福者也。

translations.literal: Therefore the sage kings of antiquity took the suspended signs as their model to extend transforming influence, examined the many portents to achieve good order, to grant the seasons to the people, to verify the records of things, cultivated their virtue to accord with the celestial measures, corrected their faults to be careful of calamities—leaving danger for safety, turning misfortune into blessing.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore the sage kings of antiquity took the celestial signs as their model to extend their transforming influence, examined the many portents to achieve good order, granted the seasons to the people, verified the records of things, cultivated their virtue to accord with the celestial measures, corrected their faults to guard against calamities—leaving danger for safety and turning misfortune into blessing.

sentences.zh: 夫其五緯七紀之名數，中官外官之位次，淩歷犯守之所主，飛流彗孛之所應，前史載之備矣。

translations.literal: As for the names and numbers of the five planets and seven regulators, the positions of the inner and outer official stars, what transits, invasions, and stations govern, and what meteors, comets, and broom-stars correspond to—earlier histories record them fully.
translations.idiomatic: As for the names and numbers of the five planets and seven regulators, the positions of the inner and outer official stars, what transits, invasions, and stations govern, and what meteors, comets, and broom-stars portend—earlier histories record them fully.

sentences.zh: 武德年中，薛頤、庾儉等相次為太史令，雖各善於占候，而無所發明。

translations.literal: In the Wude years, Xue Yi, Yu Jian, and others in succession served as Director of the Astronomy Bureau; though each was skilled at divination and observation, none made any innovations.
translations.idiomatic: During the Wude era, Xue Yi, Yu Jian, and others served in succession as Director of the Astronomy Bureau; though each was skilled at divination and observation, none made any innovations.

sentences.zh: 貞觀初，將仕郎直太史李淳風始上言靈臺候儀是後魏遺範，法制疏略，難為占步。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Zhenguan era, the Attendant Gentleman on probation attached to the Astronomy Bureau, Li Chunfeng, first submitted that the Lingtai observatory instruments were a legacy of Northern Wei, their regulations crude and summary, and difficult to use for astronomical computation.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Zhenguan era, Li Chunfeng, Attendant Gentleman on probation attached to the Astronomy Bureau, first submitted that the Lingtai observatory instruments were a Northern Wei legacy—crude in regulation and difficult to use for astronomical computation.

sentences.zh: 太宗因令淳風改造渾儀，鑄銅為之，至七年造成。

translations.literal: Emperor Taizong therefore ordered Chunfeng to redesign the armillary sphere, casting it in bronze; it was completed in the seventh year.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Taizong therefore ordered Chunfeng to redesign the armillary sphere, casting it in bronze; it was completed in the seventh year.

sentences.zh: 淳風因撰《法象志》七卷，以論前代渾儀得失之差，語在《淳風傳》。

translations.literal: Chunfeng thereupon compiled the Record of Celestial Forms in seven scrolls, discussing the gains and losses and discrepancies of armillary spheres in earlier ages; the account is in his biography.
translations.idiomatic: Chunfeng thereupon compiled the Record of Celestial Forms in seven scrolls, discussing the gains, losses, and discrepancies of armillary spheres in earlier ages; the account is in his biography.

sentences.zh: 其所造渾儀，太宗令置於凝暉閣以用測候，既在宮中，尋而失其所在。

translations.literal: The armillary sphere he made—Emperor Taizong ordered it placed in the Ninghui Pavilion for measurement and observation—being within the palace, soon its whereabouts were lost.
translations.idiomatic: The armillary sphere he made was ordered placed in the Ninghui Pavilion for measurement and observation; being within the palace, its whereabouts were soon lost.

sentences.zh: 玄宗，太史頻奏日蝕不效，詔沙門一行改造新曆。

translations.literal: Under Emperor Xuanzong, the Astronomy Bureau repeatedly reported that solar eclipses did not match predictions, and an edict ordered the monk Yixing to revise the calendar anew.
translations.idiomatic: Under Emperor Xuanzong, the Astronomy Bureau repeatedly reported that solar eclipses did not match predictions, and an edict ordered the monk Yixing to revise the calendar anew.

sentences.zh: 一行奏云：「今欲創曆立元，須知黃道進退，請太史令測候星度。」

translations.literal: Yixing memorialized, saying: "We now wish to establish a new calendar and set the epoch, and must know the ecliptic's advance and retreat. I request the Director of the Astronomy Bureau measure and observe the star degrees."
translations.idiomatic: Yixing memorialized, saying: "We now wish to establish a new calendar and set the epoch, and must know the ecliptic's advance and retreat. I request the Director of the Astronomy Bureau measure and observe the star degrees."

sentences.zh: 有司云：「承前唯依赤道推步，官無黃道遊儀，無由測候。」

translations.literal: The responsible officials said: "Following precedent we rely only on the equator for computation. The office has no ecliptic traveling instrument, and there is no means to measure and observe."
translations.idiomatic: The responsible officials said: "Following precedent we rely only on the equator for computation. The office has no ecliptic traveling instrument, and there is no means to measure and observe."

sentences.zh: 時率府兵曹梁令瓚待制於麗正書院，因造遊儀木樣，甚為精密。

translations.literal: At that time Liang Lingzan, military staff officer of the Shuai Prefecture, was on special assignment at the Lizheng Academy; he therefore made a wooden model of the traveling instrument, which was extremely precise.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Liang Lingzan, military staff officer of the Shuai Prefecture, was on special assignment at the Lizheng Academy; he therefore made a wooden model of the traveling instrument, which was extremely precise.

sentences.zh: 一行乃上言曰：「黃道游儀，古有其術而無其器。

translations.literal: Yixing then submitted, saying: "The ecliptic traveling instrument—antiquity had the method but not the device.
translations.idiomatic: Yixing then submitted, saying: "The ecliptic traveling instrument—antiquity had the method but not the device.

sentences.zh: 以黃道隨天運動，難用常儀格之，故昔人潛思皆不能得。

translations.literal: Because the ecliptic moves with the turning of heaven, it is difficult to fix with a constant instrument; therefore men of old who pondered deeply could not obtain it.
translations.idiomatic: Because the ecliptic moves with the turning of heaven, it is difficult to fix with a constant instrument; therefore men of old who pondered deeply could not obtain it.

sentences.zh: 今梁令瓚創造此圖，日道月交，莫不自然契合，既于推步尤要，望就書院更以銅鐵為之，庶得考驗星度，無有差舛。」

translations.literal: Now Liang Lingzan has created this diagram—the solar path and lunar crossing naturally accord without discrepancy; it is especially essential for computation. I hope it may be recast in bronze and iron at the academy, so that star degrees may be verified without error."
translations.idiomatic: Now Liang Lingzan has created this diagram—the solar path and lunar crossing naturally accord without discrepancy; it is especially essential for computation. I hope it may be recast in bronze and iron at the academy, so that star degrees may be verified without error."

sentences.zh: 從之，至十三年造成。

translations.literal: The request was approved; it was completed in the thirteenth year.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved; it was completed in the thirteenth year.

sentences.zh: 又上疏曰：

translations.literal: He also submitted a memorial, saying:
translations.idiomatic: He also submitted a memorial, saying:

sentences.zh: 自周室衰微，疇人喪職，其制度遺象，莫有傳者。

translations.literal: From the decline of the Zhou house, the calendar officers lost their offices; their institutions and preserved instruments had no transmitters.
translations.idiomatic: From the decline of the Zhou house, the calendar officers lost their offices; their institutions and preserved instruments had no transmitters.

sentences.zh: 漢興，丞相張蒼首創律曆之學。

translations.literal: When Han arose, Chancellor Zhang Cang first established the study of pitch-pipes and calendrics.
translations.idiomatic: When Han arose, Chancellor Zhang Cang first established the study of pitch-pipes and calendrics.

sentences.zh: 至武帝詔司馬遷等更造漢曆，乃定東西、立晷儀、下漏刻，以追二十八宿相距星度，與古不同。

translations.literal: At Emperor Wu's edict, Sima Qian and others further made the Han calendar, fixing east and west, setting up the gnomon instrument and lowering the clepsydra graduations, to pursue the star degrees between the twenty-eight lodges—different from antiquity.
translations.idiomatic: At Emperor Wu's edict, Sima Qian and others further made the Han calendar, fixing east and west, setting up the gnomon instrument and lowering the clepsydra graduations, to pursue the star degrees between the twenty-eight lodges—different from antiquity.

sentences.zh: 故唐都分天部，洛下閎運算轉曆，今赤道曆星度，則其遺法也。

translations.literal: Therefore Tang Du divided the celestial departments; Luoxia Hong computed and turned the calendar—the present equatorial lodge star degrees are his transmitted method.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore Tang Du divided the celestial departments; Luoxia Hong computed and turned the calendar—the present equatorial lodge star degrees are his transmitted method.

sentences.zh: 後漢永元中，左中郎將賈逵奏言：「臣前上傅安等用黃道度日月，弦望多近。

translations.literal: In the Yongyuan era of Later Han, Left Palace Attendant Jia Kui memorialized, saying: "I previously submitted that Fu An and others, using the ecliptic to measure the Sun and Moon, found new and full moons mostly close.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yongyuan era of Later Han, Left Palace Attendant Jia Kui memorialized, saying: "I previously submitted that Fu An and others, using the ecliptic to measure the Sun and Moon, found new and full moons mostly close.

sentences.zh: 史官壹以赤道度之，不與天合，至差一日以上。

translations.literal: The astronomy officers uniformly measured by the equator; it did not accord with heaven, differing by more than a full day.
translations.idiomatic: The astronomy officers uniformly measured by the equator; it did not accord with heaven, differing by more than a full day.

sentences.zh: 願請太史官日月宿簿及星度課，與待詔星官考校。」

translations.literal: I wish to request the astronomy office's ledgers of the Sun, Moon, and lodges and the star-degree assessments, to be examined and corrected with the star-official attendants awaiting edict."
translations.idiomatic: I wish to request the astronomy office's ledgers of the Sun, Moon, and lodges and the star-degree assessments, to be examined and corrected with the star-official attendants awaiting edict."

sentences.zh: 奏可。

translations.literal: The memorial was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was approved.

sentences.zh: 「問典星待詔姚崇等十二人，皆曰：『星圖有規法，日月實從黃道，官無其器，不知施行。』，

translations.literal: "When the canonical-star attendants awaiting edict Yao Chong and twelve others were questioned, all said: 'The star charts have regulated methods; the Sun and Moon truly follow the ecliptic. The office has no instrument, and does not know how to implement it.'
translations.idiomatic: "When the canonical-star attendants awaiting edict Yao Chong and twelve others were questioned, all said: 'The star charts have regulated methods; the Sun and Moon truly follow the ecliptic. The office has no instrument, and does not know how to implement it.'

sentences.zh: 大司農丞耿壽昌奏，以圓儀度日月行，考驗天運。

translations.literal: Grand Agriculture Assistant Geng Shouchang memorialized, using a circular instrument to measure the Sun and Moon's motion, verifying the heavenly cycle.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Agriculture Assistant Geng Shouchang memorialized, using a circular instrument to measure the Sun and Moon's motion, verifying the heavenly cycle.

sentences.zh: 日月行赤道，至牽牛、東井，日行一度，月行十五度；

translations.literal: The Sun and Moon travel the equator; at Oxherd and Eastern Well, the Sun travels one degree per day and the Moon fifteen degrees;
translations.idiomatic: The Sun and Moon travel the equator; at Oxherd and Eastern Well, the Sun travels one degree per day and the Moon fifteen degrees;

sentences.zh: 至婁、角，日行一度，月行十三度，此前代所共知也。」

translations.literal: at Bond and Horn, the Sun travels one degree per day and the Moon thirteen degrees—this earlier generations jointly knew."
translations.idiomatic: at Bond and Horn, the Sun travels one degree per day and the Moon thirteen degrees—this earlier generations jointly knew."

sentences.zh: 是歲永元四載也。

translations.literal: This was the fourth year of Yongyuan.
translations.idiomatic: This was the fourth year of Yongyuan.

sentences.zh: 明年，始詔太史造黃道銅儀。

translations.literal: The next year, an edict first ordered the Astronomy Bureau to make a bronze ecliptic instrument.
translations.idiomatic: The next year, an edict first ordered the Astronomy Bureau to make a bronze ecliptic instrument.

sentences.zh: 冬至，日在斗十九度四分度之一，與赤道定差二度。

translations.literal: At the winter solstice, the Sun was at nineteen and one-quarter degrees of Dipper, with a fixed difference of two degrees from the equator.
translations.idiomatic: At the winter solstice, the Sun was at nineteen and one-quarter degrees of Dipper, with a fixed difference of two degrees from the equator.

sentences.zh: 史官以校日月弦望，雖密近，而不為望日。

translations.literal: The astronomy officers used it to verify the Sun and Moon at new and full moon; though closely near, it was not at the day of full moon.
translations.idiomatic: The astronomy officers used it to verify the Sun and Moon at new and full moon; though closely near, it was not at the day of full moon.

sentences.zh: 儀，黃道與度運轉，難候，是以少終其事。

translations.literal: The instrument—the ecliptic turning with the degree motion—was difficult to observe; therefore they scarcely completed the task.
translations.idiomatic: The instrument—the ecliptic turning with the degree motion—was difficult to observe; therefore they scarcely completed the task.

sentences.zh: 其後劉洪因黃道渾儀，以考月行出入遲速。

translations.literal: Afterward Liu Hong, by the ecliptic armillary sphere, examined the Moon's motion in entering and leaving and its slowness and speed.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward Liu Hong, by the ecliptic armillary sphere, examined the Moon's motion in entering and leaving and its slowness and speed.

sentences.zh: 而後代理曆者不遵其法，更從赤道命文，以驗賈逵所言，差謬益甚，此理曆者之大惑也。

translations.literal: But later calendar-makers did not follow his method, again assigning lodges from the equator to verify what Jia Kui said—the errors grew ever greater; this is the great confusion of those who regulate calendrics.
translations.idiomatic: But later calendar-makers did not follow his method, again assigning lodges from the equator to verify what Jia Kui said—the errors grew ever greater; this is the great confusion of those who regulate calendrics.

sentences.zh: 今靈臺鐵儀，後魏明元時都匠解蘭所造，規制樸略，度刻不均，赤道不動，乃如膠柱，不置黃道，進退無准。

translations.literal: The present Lingtai iron instrument was made by the master craftsman Xie Lan in the Mingyuan era of Northern Wei; its regulated form was crude and summary, its degree graduations uneven, the equator unmoving—like a glued pillar—without setting the ecliptic, advance and retreat without standard.
translations.idiomatic: The present Lingtai iron instrument was made by the master craftsman Xie Lan in the Mingyuan era of Northern Wei; its regulated form was crude and summary, its degree graduations uneven, the equator unmoving—like a glued pillar—without setting the ecliptic, advance and retreat without standard.

sentences.zh: 此據赤道月行以驗入曆遲速，多者或至十七度，少者僅出十度，不足以上稽天象，敬授人時。

translations.literal: This, relying on the equator to verify the Moon's entering the calendar for slowness and speed, in some cases reached seventeen degrees, in others barely exceeded ten degrees—insufficient to examine heavenly signs above and reverently grant the seasons to the people.
translations.idiomatic: This, relying on the equator to verify the Moon's entering the calendar for slowness and speed, in some cases reached seventeen degrees, in others barely exceeded ten degrees—insufficient to examine heavenly signs above and reverently grant the seasons to the people.

sentences.zh: 近秘閣郎中李淳風著《法象志》，備載黃道渾儀法，以玉衡旋規，別帶日道，傍列二百四十九交，以攜月游，用法頗雜，其術竟寢。

translations.literal: Recently Secretariat Gentleman Li Chunfeng authored the Record of Celestial Forms, fully recording the method of the ecliptic armillary sphere—using the jade transversal revolving ring, separately carrying the solar path, with two hundred forty-nine crossings arrayed beside to carry the Moon's travel; the method was rather complex, and the technique in the end was abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: Recently Secretariat Gentleman Li Chunfeng authored the Record of Celestial Forms, fully recording the method of the ecliptic armillary sphere—using the jade transversal revolving ring, separately carrying the solar path, with two hundred forty-nine crossings arrayed beside to carry the Moon's travel; the method was rather complex, and the technique in the end was abandoned.

sentences.zh: 臣伏承恩旨，更造遊儀，使黃道運行，以追列舍之變，因二分之中以立黃道，交於軫、奎之間，二至陟降各二十四度。

translations.literal: Your subject, receiving the gracious directive, has further made the traveling instrument, causing the ecliptic to move, to pursue the changes of the lodges; at the two equinoxes the ecliptic is established, crossing between Chariot and Strider; at the two solstices ascent and descent are each twenty-four degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Your subject, receiving the gracious directive, has further made the traveling instrument, causing the ecliptic to move, to pursue the changes of the lodges; at the two equinoxes the ecliptic is established, crossing between Chariot and Strider; at the two solstices ascent and descent are each twenty-four degrees.

sentences.zh: 黃道之內，又施白道月環，用究陰陽朓朒之數，動合天運，簡而易從，足以製器垂象，永傳不朽。

translations.literal: Within the ecliptic, a white-path lunar ring is also set, to investigate the numbers of yin and yang, waxing and waning; moving in accord with the heavenly cycle, simple and easy to follow—sufficient to make instruments and suspend signs, transmitted forever without perishing.
translations.idiomatic: Within the ecliptic, a white-path lunar ring is also set, to investigate the numbers of yin and yang, waxing and waning; moving in accord with the heavenly cycle, simple and easy to follow—sufficient to make instruments and suspend signs, transmitted forever without perishing.

sentences.zh: 於是玄宗親為製銘，置之於靈臺以考星度。

translations.literal: Thereupon Emperor Xuanzong personally composed an inscription and placed it at the Lingtai to examine star degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Emperor Xuanzong personally composed an inscription and placed it at the Lingtai to examine star degrees.

sentences.zh: 其二十八宿及中外官與古經不同者，凡數十條。

translations.literal: The twenty-eight lodges and inner and outer official stars that differ from the ancient canon number several tens of entries.
translations.idiomatic: The twenty-eight lodges and inner and outer official stars that differ from the ancient canon number several tens of entries.

sentences.zh: 又詔一行與梁令瓚及諸術士更造渾天儀，鑄銅為圓天之象，上具列宿赤道及周天度數。

translations.literal: An edict also ordered Yixing, Liang Lingzan, and various technicians to further make an armillary celestial globe, casting bronze as the image of the round heaven, above equipped with the lodges, equator, and degrees of the full circuit.
translations.idiomatic: An edict also ordered Yixing, Liang Lingzan, and various technicians to further make an armillary celestial globe, casting bronze as the image of the round heaven, above equipped with the lodges, equator, and degrees of the full circuit.

sentences.zh: 注水激輪，令其自轉，一日一夜，天轉一周。

translations.literal: Water was poured to drive the wheel, causing it to turn of itself; in one day and one night, heaven turns one circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Water was poured to drive the wheel, causing it to turn of itself; in one day and one night, heaven turns one circuit.

sentences.zh: 又別置二輪絡在天外，綴以日月，令得運行。

translations.literal: Two wheels were separately set linked outside heaven, carrying the Sun and Moon, causing them to move.
translations.idiomatic: Two wheels were separately set linked outside heaven, carrying the Sun and Moon, causing them to move.

sentences.zh: 每天西轉一幣，日東行一度，月行十三度十九分度之七，凡二十九轉有餘而日月會，三百六十五轉而日行匝。

translations.literal: Each day heaven turns west one coin-width; the Sun travels east one degree, the Moon thirteen and seven-nineteenths degrees; in twenty-nine-odd turns the Sun and Moon meet; in three hundred sixty-five turns the Sun completes a circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Each day heaven turns west one coin-width; the Sun travels east one degree, the Moon thirteen and seven-nineteenths degrees; in twenty-nine-odd turns the Sun and Moon meet; in three hundred sixty-five turns the Sun completes a circuit.

sentences.zh: 仍置木櫃以為地平，令儀半在地下，晦明朔望，遲速有准。

translations.literal: A wooden cabinet was still set as the horizon, causing half the instrument to be below ground; dark moon, bright moon, new moon, and full moon, slowness and speed had standards.
translations.idiomatic: A wooden cabinet was still set as the horizon, causing half the instrument to be below ground; dark moon, bright moon, new moon, and full moon, slowness and speed had standards.

sentences.zh: 又立二木人于地平之上，前置鐘鼓以候辰刻，每一刻自然擊鼓，每辰則自然撞鐘。

translations.literal: Two wooden figures were also set on the horizon, with bell and drum placed before to mark the double-hours and graduations; each graduation naturally struck the drum, each double-hour naturally struck the bell.
translations.idiomatic: Two wooden figures were also set on the horizon, with bell and drum placed before to mark the double-hours and graduations; each graduation naturally struck the drum, each double-hour naturally struck the bell.

sentences.zh: 皆于櫃中各施輪軸，鉤鍵交錯，關鎖相持。

translations.literal: All within the cabinet wheels and axles were set, hooks and keys interlaced, bolts and locks mutually holding.
translations.idiomatic: All within the cabinet wheels and axles were set, hooks and keys interlaced, bolts and locks mutually holding.

sentences.zh: 既與天道合同，當時共稱其妙。

translations.literal: Being in accord with the heavenly Way, at the time all together praised its marvel.
translations.idiomatic: Being in accord with the heavenly Way, at the time all together praised its marvel.

sentences.zh: 鑄成，命之曰「水運渾天俯視圖」，置於武成殿前以示百僚。

translations.literal: When casting was complete, it was named the "Water-Driven Armillary Celestial Globe Viewed from Above" and placed before the Wucheng Hall to show the hundred officials.
translations.idiomatic: When casting was complete, it was named the "Water-Driven Armillary Celestial Globe Viewed from Above" and placed before the Wucheng Hall to show the hundred officials.

sentences.zh: 無幾而銅鐵漸澀，不能自轉，遂收置於集賢院，不復行用。

translations.literal: Before long the bronze and iron gradually stiffened and could not turn of itself; it was then collected and stored in the Jixian Academy, no longer used.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the bronze and iron gradually stiffened and could not turn of itself; it was then collected and stored in the Jixian Academy, no longer used.

sentences.zh: 今錄遊儀制度及所測星度異同，分遣使諸州所測日晷長短，李淳風、僧一行所定十二次分野，武德已來交蝕及五星祥變，著於篇。

translations.literal: Now recorded are the regulations of the traveling instrument and the star degrees measured, their similarities and differences; separately dispatched envoys to the various prefectures to measure the lengths of solar shadows; the twelve divisions and field-allotments fixed by Li Chunfeng and the monk Yixing; eclipses and the five planets' auspicious changes since Wude—set forth in this treatise.
translations.idiomatic: Now recorded are the regulations of the traveling instrument and the star degrees measured, their similarities and differences; separately dispatched envoys to the various prefectures to measure the lengths of solar shadows; the twelve divisions and field-allotments fixed by Li Chunfeng and the monk Yixing; eclipses and the five planets' auspicious changes since Wude—set forth in this treatise.

sentences.zh: 旋樞雙環：外一丈四尺六寸一分，豎八分，厚三分，直徑四尺五寸九分，即古所謂旋儀也。

translations.literal: Rotating-pivot double ring: outer one zhang four chi six cun one fen, vertical eight fen, thick three fen, diameter four chi five cun nine fen—the ancient so-called rotating instrument.
translations.idiomatic: Rotating-pivot double ring: outer one zhang four chi six cun one fen, vertical eight fen, thick three fen, diameter four chi five cun nine fen—the ancient so-called rotating instrument.

sentences.zh: 南北斜兩極，上下循規各三十四度，兩面各畫周天度數。

translations.literal: North and south oblique poles, above and below following the ring each thirty-four degrees; on both faces the degrees of heaven's full circuit are painted.
translations.idiomatic: North and south oblique poles, above and below following the ring each thirty-four degrees; on both faces the degrees of heaven's full circuit are painted.

sentences.zh: 一面加釘，並用銀飾，使東西運轉如渾天遊儀。

translations.literal: On one face nails are added, all silver ornamented, causing east-west rotation like the armillary traveling instrument.
translations.idiomatic: On one face nails are added, all silver ornamented, causing east-west rotation like the armillary traveling instrument.

sentences.zh: 中旋樞軸至兩極首內，孔徑大兩度半，長與旋環徑齊，並用古尺四分為度。

translations.literal: The central rotating-pivot axle to within the two pole heads, bore diameter two and a half degrees, length equal to the rotating ring's diameter—all using the ancient chi with four fen as one degree.
translations.idiomatic: The central rotating-pivot axle to within the two pole heads, bore diameter two and a half degrees, length equal to the rotating ring's diameter—all using the ancient chi with four fen as one degree.

sentences.zh: 玉衡望筒：長四尺五寸八分，廣一寸二分，厚一寸，孔徑六分，古用玉飾之。

translations.literal: Jade-transversal sighting tube: length four chi five cun eight fen, width one cun two fen, thickness one cun, bore diameter six fen; antiquity used jade to ornament it.
translations.idiomatic: Jade-transversal sighting tube: length four chi five cun eight fen, width one cun two fen, thickness one cun, bore diameter six fen; antiquity used jade to ornament it.

sentences.zh: 玉衡，衡施於軸中，旋運持正，用窺七曜及列星之闊狹，外方內圓，孔徑一度半，周日輪也。

translations.literal: The jade transversal, the transversal set in the axle's center, rotating and holding true, used to sight the seven luminaries and the lodges' breadth and narrowness—outer square inner round, bore diameter one and a half degrees, the circuit of the daily wheel.
translations.idiomatic: The jade transversal, the transversal set in the axle's center, rotating and holding true, used to sight the seven luminaries and the lodges' breadth and narrowness—outer square inner round, bore diameter one and a half degrees, the circuit of the daily wheel.

sentences.zh: 陽經雙環：外一丈七尺三寸，內一丈四尺六寸四分，廣四寸，厚四分，直徑五尺四寸四分，置於子午。

translations.literal: Yang meridian double ring: outer one zhang seven chi three cun, inner one zhang four chi six cun four fen, width four cun, thickness four fen, diameter five chi four cun four fen, set at south and north noon.
translations.idiomatic: Yang meridian double ring: outer one zhang seven chi three cun, inner one zhang four chi six cun four fen, width four cun, thickness four fen, diameter five chi four cun four fen, set at south and north noon.

sentences.zh: 左右用八柱相固，兩面畫周天度數，一面加釘，並銀飾之。

translations.literal: Left and right eight pillars mutually fixed; on both faces the degrees of heaven's full circuit are painted; on one face nails are added, all silver ornamented.
translations.idiomatic: Left and right eight pillars mutually fixed; on both faces the degrees of heaven's full circuit are painted; on one face nails are added, all silver ornamented.

sentences.zh: 半出地上，半入地下，雙間挾樞軸及玉衡望筒，旋環於中也。

translations.literal: Half emerges above ground, half enters below ground; the double interval clasps the pivot axle and jade-transversal sighting tube, the rotating ring in the center.
translations.idiomatic: Half emerges above ground, half enters below ground; the double interval clasps the pivot axle and jade-transversal sighting tube, the rotating ring in the center.

sentences.zh: 陰緯單環：外內廣厚周徑，皆准陽經，與陽經相銜各半，內外俱齊。

translations.literal: Yin latitude single ring: outer and inner width, thickness, and full circuit diameter all follow the yang meridian; with the yang meridian each links half, inner and outer both level.
translations.idiomatic: Yin latitude single ring: outer and inner width, thickness, and full circuit diameter all follow the yang meridian; with the yang meridian each links half, inner and outer both level.

sentences.zh: 面平上為天，以下為地，橫周陽環，謂之陰渾也。

translations.literal: The face above level is heaven; below is earth; horizontally circling the yang ring—this is called the yin armillary.
translations.idiomatic: The face above level is heaven; below is earth; horizontally circling the yang ring—this is called the yin armillary.

sentences.zh: 面上為兩界，內外為周天百刻。

translations.literal: On the face above are two boundaries; inner and outer are the hundred graduations of heaven's full circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On the face above are two boundaries; inner and outer are the hundred graduations of heaven's full circuit.

sentences.zh: 平上御製銘序及書，並金為字。

translations.literal: On the level above are the imperially composed inscription preface and text, all characters in gold.
translations.idiomatic: On the level above are the imperially composed inscription preface and text, all characters in gold.

sentences.zh: 天頂單環：外一丈七尺三寸，豎廣八分，厚三分，直徑五尺四寸四分。

translations.literal: Celestial apex single ring: outer one zhang seven chi three cun, vertical width eight fen, thickness three fen, diameter five chi four cun four fen.
translations.idiomatic: Celestial apex single ring: outer one zhang seven chi three cun, vertical width eight fen, thickness three fen, diameter five chi four cun four fen.

sentences.zh: 當中國人頂之上，東西當卯酉之中，稍南，使見日出入，令與陽經、陰緯相固，如殼之裹黃。

translations.literal: At the apex above the Central Land's people, east-west at the center of mao and you, slightly south, causing the Sun's emergence and setting to be seen; causing it to be fixed with the yang meridian and yin latitude, like a shell wrapping the yellow.
translations.idiomatic: At the apex above the Central Land's people, east-west at the center of mao and you, slightly south, causing the Sun's emergence and setting to be seen; causing it to be fixed with the yang meridian and yin latitude, like a shell wrapping the yellow.

sentences.zh: 南去赤道三十六度，去黃道十二度，去北極五十五度，去南北平各九十一度強。

translations.literal: South from the equator thirty-six degrees, from the ecliptic twelve degrees, from the north pole fifty-five degrees, from north and south level each ninety-one degrees strong.
translations.idiomatic: South from the equator thirty-six degrees, from the ecliptic twelve degrees, from the north pole fifty-five degrees, from north and south level each ninety-one degrees strong.

sentences.zh: 赤道單環：外一丈四尺五寸九分，橫八分，厚三分，直徑四尺九寸。

translations.literal: Equator single ring: outer one zhang four chi five cun nine fen, horizontal eight fen, thickness three fen, diameter four chi nine cun.
translations.idiomatic: Equator single ring: outer one zhang four chi five cun nine fen, horizontal eight fen, thickness three fen, diameter four chi nine cun.

sentences.zh: 赤道者，當天之中，二十八宿之列位也。

translations.literal: The equator is at heaven's center—the arrayed positions of the twenty-eight lodges.
translations.idiomatic: The equator is at heaven's center—the arrayed positions of the twenty-eight lodges.

sentences.zh: 其本，後魏解蘭所造也。

translations.literal: Its original was made by Xie Lan of Northern Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Its original was made by Xie Lan of Northern Wei.

sentences.zh: 因著雙規，不能運動。

translations.literal: Because double rings were attached, it could not move.
translations.idiomatic: Because double rings were attached, it could not move.

sentences.zh: 臣今所造者，上列周天星度，使轉運隨天，仍度穿一穴，隨穴退交，不有差謬。

translations.literal: What your subject has now made lists the star degrees of heaven's full circuit above, causing rotation to follow heaven; still a hole is bored through the degree, following the hole retreating at crossing, without error.
translations.idiomatic: What your subject has now made lists the star degrees of heaven's full circuit above, causing rotation to follow heaven; still a hole is bored through the degree, following the hole retreating at crossing, without error.

sentences.zh: 即知古者秋分，日在角五度，今在軫十三度；

translations.literal: Thus one knows that in antiquity at the autumn equinox the Sun was at five degrees of Horn; now it is at thirteen degrees of Chariot;
translations.idiomatic: Thus one knows that in antiquity at the autumn equinox the Sun was at five degrees of Horn; now it is at thirteen degrees of Chariot;

sentences.zh: 冬至，日在牽牛初，今在斗十度。

translations.literal: at the winter solstice the Sun was at the beginning of Oxherd; now it is at ten degrees of Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: at the winter solstice the Sun was at the beginning of Oxherd; now it is at ten degrees of Dipper.

sentences.zh: 擬隨差卻退，故置穴也。

translations.literal: Intending to follow the difference retreating backward, therefore the hole is set.
translations.idiomatic: Intending to follow the difference retreating backward, therefore the hole is set.

sentences.zh: 傍在卯酉之南，上去天頂三十六度而橫置之。

translations.literal: Beside it south of mao and you, above going to the celestial apex thirty-six degrees and set horizontally.
translations.idiomatic: Beside it south of mao and you, above going to the celestial apex thirty-six degrees and set horizontally.

sentences.zh: 黃道單環：外一丈五尺四寸一分，橫八分，厚四分，直徑四尺八寸四分。

translations.literal: Ecliptic single ring: outer one zhang five chi four cun one fen, horizontal eight fen, thickness four fen, diameter four chi eight cun four fen.
translations.idiomatic: Ecliptic single ring: outer one zhang five chi four cun one fen, horizontal eight fen, thickness four fen, diameter four chi eight cun four fen.

sentences.zh: 日之所行，故名黃道。

translations.literal: Where the Sun travels—therefore named the ecliptic.
translations.idiomatic: Where the Sun travels—therefore named the ecliptic.

sentences.zh: 古人知有其事，竟無其器，遂使太陽陟降，積歲有差。

translations.literal: Men of old knew the matter existed but ultimately had no instrument; thus the Sun's ascent and descent accumulated years of discrepancy.
translations.idiomatic: Men of old knew the matter existed but ultimately had no instrument; thus the Sun's ascent and descent accumulated years of discrepancy.

sentences.zh: 月及五星，亦隨日度出入，規制不知准的，斟量為率，疏闊尤多。

translations.literal: The Moon and five planets also follow the Sun's degrees in entering and leaving; regulated form did not know the mark, measuring and setting the rate—crude and broad, especially many.
translations.idiomatic: The Moon and five planets also follow the Sun's degrees in entering and leaving; regulated form did not know the mark, measuring and setting the rate—crude and broad, especially many.

sentences.zh: 臣今創置此環，置於赤道環內，仍開合使隨轉運，出入四十八度，而極畫兩方，東西列周天度數，南北列百刻，使見日知時，不有差謬。

translations.literal: Your subject now newly sets this ring, placed within the equator ring, still opening and closing causing it to follow rotation, entering and leaving forty-eight degrees; at the poles both sides are painted, east-west listing heaven's full-circuit degrees, south-north listing the hundred graduations, causing the Sun to be seen and time known, without error.
translations.idiomatic: Your subject now newly sets this ring, placed within the equator ring, still opening and closing causing it to follow rotation, entering and leaving forty-eight degrees; at the poles both sides are painted, east-west listing heaven's full-circuit degrees, south-north listing the hundred graduations, causing the Sun to be seen and time known, without error.

sentences.zh: 上列三百六十策，與用卦相准，度穿一穴，與赤道相交。

translations.literal: Above are listed three hundred sixty tally-rods, matching the used hexagrams; a hole is bored through the degree, intersecting with the equator.
translations.idiomatic: Above are listed three hundred sixty tally-rods, matching the used hexagrams; a hole is bored through the degree, intersecting with the equator.

sentences.zh: 白道月環：外一丈五尺一寸五分，橫度八分，厚三分，直徑四尺七寸六分。

translations.literal: White-path lunar ring: outer one zhang five chi one cun five fen, horizontal width eight fen, thickness three fen, diameter four chi seven cun six fen.
translations.idiomatic: White-path lunar ring: outer one zhang five chi one cun five fen, horizontal width eight fen, thickness three fen, diameter four chi seven cun six fen.

sentences.zh: 月行有迂曲遲疾，與日行緩急相反。

translations.literal: The Moon's motion has winding curves, slowness and speed, opposite to the Sun's motion in ease and urgency.
translations.idiomatic: The Moon's motion has winding curves, slowness and speed, opposite to the Sun's motion in ease and urgency.

sentences.zh: 古無其器，今創置於黃道環內，使就黃道為交合，出入六十度，以測每夜行度。

translations.literal: Antiquity had no instrument; now newly set within the ecliptic ring, causing it to take the ecliptic as crossing and union, entering and leaving sixty degrees, to measure each night's traveled degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Antiquity had no instrument; now newly set within the ecliptic ring, causing it to take the ecliptic as crossing and union, entering and leaving sixty degrees, to measure each night's traveled degrees.

sentences.zh: 上畫周天度數，穿一穴，擬移交會，並用銅鐵為之。

translations.literal: Above are painted heaven's full-circuit degrees; a hole is bored, intending to follow the shifting crossing and union—all cast in bronze and iron.
translations.idiomatic: Above are painted heaven's full-circuit degrees; a hole is bored, intending to follow the shifting crossing and union—all cast in bronze and iron.

sentences.zh: 李淳風《法象志》說有此日月兩環，在旋儀環上。

translations.literal: Li Chunfeng's Record of Celestial Forms says these Sun and Moon two rings are on the rotating-instrument ring.
translations.idiomatic: Li Chunfeng's Record of Celestial Forms says these Sun and Moon two rings are on the rotating-instrument ring.

sentences.zh: 既用玉衡，不得遂於玉衡內別安一尺望筒。

translations.literal: Since the jade transversal is used, one cannot then separately install within the jade transversal another one-chi sighting tube.
translations.idiomatic: Since the jade transversal is used, one cannot then separately install within the jade transversal another one-chi sighting tube.

sentences.zh: 運用既難，其器已澀。

translations.literal: Application being difficult, the instrument already stiffened.
translations.idiomatic: Application being difficult, the instrument already stiffened.

sentences.zh: 游儀四柱，龍各高四尺七寸。

translations.literal: Traveling instrument four pillars—the dragons each four chi seven cun high.
translations.idiomatic: Traveling instrument four pillars—the dragons each four chi seven cun high.

sentences.zh: 水槽、山各高一尺七寸五分。

translations.literal: Water trough and mountain each one chi seven cun five fen high.
translations.idiomatic: Water trough and mountain each one chi seven cun five fen high.

sentences.zh: 槽長六尺九寸，高廣各四寸。

translations.literal: Trough length six chi nine cun, height and width each four cun.
translations.idiomatic: Trough length six chi nine cun, height and width each four cun.

sentences.zh: 水池深一寸，廣一寸五分。

translations.literal: Water pool depth one cun, width one cun five fen.
translations.idiomatic: Water pool depth one cun, width one cun five fen.

sentences.zh: 龍者能興雲雨，故以飾柱。

translations.literal: Dragons can raise cloud and rain—therefore used to ornament the pillars.
translations.idiomatic: Dragons can raise cloud and rain—therefore used to ornament the pillars.

sentences.zh: 柱在四維，龍下有山雲，俱在水準槽上，並銅為之。

translations.literal: The pillars at the four corners; below the dragons are mountain and cloud—all on the water-level trough, all cast in bronze.
translations.idiomatic: The pillars at the four corners; below the dragons are mountain and cloud—all on the water-level trough, all cast in bronze.

sentences.zh: 游儀初成，太史所測二十八宿等與《經》同異狀：

translations.literal: When the traveling instrument was first completed, the Astronomy Bureau's measurements of the twenty-eight lodges and others, compared with the Canon, same and different in condition:
translations.idiomatic: When the traveling instrument was first completed, the Astronomy Bureau's measurements of the twenty-eight lodges and others, compared with the Canon, same and different in condition:

sentences.zh: 角二星，十二度；

translations.literal: Horn two stars, twelve degrees;
translations.idiomatic: Horn two stars, twelve degrees;

sentences.zh: 赤道黃道度與古同。

translations.literal: equatorial and ecliptic degrees same as antiquity.
translations.idiomatic: equatorial and ecliptic degrees same as antiquity.

sentences.zh: 舊《經》去極九十一度，今則九十三度半。

translations.literal: The old Canon's departure from the pole ninety-one degrees; now ninety-three and a half degrees.
translations.idiomatic: The old Canon's departure from the pole ninety-one degrees; now ninety-three and a half degrees.

sentences.zh: 《星經》云：「角去極九十一度，距星正當赤道，其黃道在赤道南，不經角中。」

translations.literal: The Star Canon says: "Horn's departure from the pole ninety-one degrees; the distance star is directly at the equator; its ecliptic is south of the equator, not passing through Horn's center."
translations.idiomatic: The Star Canon says: "Horn's departure from the pole ninety-one degrees; the distance star is directly at the equator; its ecliptic is south of the equator, not passing through Horn's center."

sentences.zh: 今測角在赤道南二度半，黃道復經角中，即與天象符合。

translations.literal: Now measured, Horn is two and a half degrees south of the equator; the ecliptic again passes through Horn's center—thus accord with the heavenly image.
translations.idiomatic: Now measured, Horn is two and a half degrees south of the equator; the ecliptic again passes through Horn's center—thus accord with the heavenly image.

sentences.zh: 亢四星，九度。

translations.literal: Neck four stars, nine degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Neck four stars, nine degrees.

sentences.zh: 舊去極八十九度，今九十一度半。

translations.literal: Old departure from pole eighty-nine degrees; now ninety-one and a half degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Old departure from pole eighty-nine degrees; now ninety-one and a half degrees.

sentences.zh: 氐四星，十六度。

translations.literal: Root four stars, sixteen degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Root four stars, sixteen degrees.

sentences.zh: 舊去極九十四度，今九十八度。

translations.literal: Old departure from pole ninety-four degrees; now ninety-eight degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Old departure from pole ninety-four degrees; now ninety-eight degrees.

sentences.zh: 房四星，五度。

translations.literal: Room four stars, five degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Room four stars, five degrees.

sentences.zh: 舊去極一百八度，今一百一十度半。

translations.literal: Old departure from pole one hundred eight degrees; now one hundred ten and a half degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Old departure from pole one hundred eight degrees; now one hundred ten and a half degrees.

sentences.zh: 心三星，五度。

translations.literal: Heart three stars, five degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Heart three stars, five degrees.

sentences.zh: 舊去極一百八度，今一百一十一度。

translations.literal: Old departure from pole one hundred eight degrees; now one hundred eleven degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Old departure from pole one hundred eight degrees; now one hundred eleven degrees.

sentences.zh: 尾九星，十八度。

translations.literal: Tail nine stars, eighteen degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Tail nine stars, eighteen degrees.

sentences.zh: 舊去極一百二十度，一云一百四十一度，今一百二十四度。

translations.literal: Old departure from pole one hundred twenty degrees; one account one hundred forty-one degrees; now one hundred twenty-four degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Old departure from pole one hundred twenty degrees; one account one hundred forty-one degrees; now one hundred twenty-four degrees.

sentences.zh: 箕四星，十一度。

translations.literal: Winnowing Basket four stars, eleven degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Winnowing Basket four stars, eleven degrees.

sentences.zh: 舊去極一百一十八度，今一百二十度。

translations.literal: Old departure from pole one hundred eighteen degrees; now one hundred twenty degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Old departure from pole one hundred eighteen degrees; now one hundred twenty degrees.

sentences.zh: 南斗六星，二十六度。

translations.literal: Southern Dipper six stars, twenty-six degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Southern Dipper six stars, twenty-six degrees.

sentences.zh: 舊去極一百一十六度，今一百一十九度。

translations.literal: Old departure from pole one hundred sixteen degrees; now one hundred nineteen degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Old departure from pole one hundred sixteen degrees; now one hundred nineteen degrees.

sentences.zh: 牽牛六星，八度。

translations.literal: Oxherd six stars, eight degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Oxherd six stars, eight degrees.

sentences.zh: 舊去極一百六度，今一百四度。

translations.literal: Old departure from pole one hundred six degrees; now one hundred four degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Old departure from pole one hundred six degrees; now one hundred four degrees.

sentences.zh: 須女四星，十二度。

translations.literal: Bond Maiden four stars, twelve degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Bond Maiden four stars, twelve degrees.

sentences.zh: 舊去極一百度，今一百一度。

translations.literal: Old departure from pole one hundred degrees; now one hundred one degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Old departure from pole one hundred degrees; now one hundred one degrees.

sentences.zh: 虛二星，十度。

translations.literal: Emptiness two stars, ten degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Emptiness two stars, ten degrees.

sentences.zh: 舊去極一百四度，今一百一度。

translations.literal: Old departure from pole one hundred four degrees; now one hundred one degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Old departure from pole one hundred four degrees; now one hundred one degrees.

sentences.zh: 北星舊圖入虛宿，今測在須女九度。

translations.literal: The north star in old charts entered Emptiness lodge; now measured at nine degrees of Bond Maiden.
translations.idiomatic: The north star in old charts entered Emptiness lodge; now measured at nine degrees of Bond Maiden.

sentences.zh: 危三星，十七度。

translations.literal: Rooftop three stars, seventeen degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Rooftop three stars, seventeen degrees.

sentences.zh: 舊去極九十七度，今九十七度。

translations.literal: Old departure from pole ninety-seven degrees; now ninety-seven degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Old departure from pole ninety-seven degrees; now ninety-seven degrees.

sentences.zh: 北星舊圖入危宿，今測在虛六度半。

translations.literal: The north star in old charts entered Rooftop lodge; now measured at six and a half degrees of Emptiness.
translations.idiomatic: The north star in old charts entered Rooftop lodge; now measured at six and a half degrees of Emptiness.

sentences.zh: 室二星，十六度。

translations.literal: Encampment two stars, sixteen degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Encampment two stars, sixteen degrees.

sentences.zh: 舊去極八十五度，今八十三度。

translations.literal: Old departure from pole eighty-five degrees; now eighty-three degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Old departure from pole eighty-five degrees; now eighty-three degrees.

sentences.zh: 東壁二星，九度。

translations.literal: Eastern Wall two stars, nine degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Wall two stars, nine degrees.

sentences.zh: 舊去極八十六度，今八十四度。

translations.literal: Old departure from pole eighty-six degrees; now eighty-four degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Old departure from pole eighty-six degrees; now eighty-four degrees.

sentences.zh: 奎十六星，十六度。

translations.literal: Strider sixteen stars, sixteen degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Strider sixteen stars, sixteen degrees.

sentences.zh: 舊去極七十六度，一云七十度，今七十三度。

translations.literal: Old departure from pole seventy-six degrees; one account seventy degrees; now seventy-three degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Old departure from pole seventy-six degrees; one account seventy degrees; now seventy-three degrees.

sentences.zh: 東壁九度，奎十六度，此錯以奎西大星為距，即損壁二度，加奎二度，今取西南大星為距，即奎、壁各不失本度。

translations.literal: Eastern Wall nine degrees, Strider sixteen degrees—this wrongly took Strider's western great star as distance star, thus reducing Wall two degrees and adding Strider two degrees; now taking the southwestern great star as distance star, Strider and Wall each keep their original degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Wall nine degrees, Strider sixteen degrees—this wrongly took Strider's western great star as distance star, thus reducing Wall two degrees and adding Strider two degrees; now taking the southwestern great star as distance star, Strider and Wall each keep their original degrees.

sentences.zh: 婁三星，十三度。

translations.literal: Bond three stars, thirteen degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Bond three stars, thirteen degrees.

sentences.zh: 舊去極八十度，今七十七度。

translations.literal: Old departure from pole eighty degrees; now seventy-seven degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Old departure from pole eighty degrees; now seventy-seven degrees.

sentences.zh: 胃三星，十四度。

translations.literal: Stomach three stars, fourteen degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Stomach three stars, fourteen degrees.

sentences.zh: 昴七星，十一度。

translations.literal: Hairy Head seven stars, eleven degrees.

translations.literal: Further north bordering the great sea—day long and evening short; after the Sun had set, the sky was just dusk; boiling one sheep's shoulder just cooked, and the east was already dawn.
translations.idiomatic: Further north bordering the great sea—day long and evening short; after the Sun had set, the sky was just dusk; boiling one sheep's shoulder just cooked, and the east was already dawn.

sentences.zh: 蓋近日出入之所云。

translations.literal: This is roughly where the Sun recently enters and leaves.
translations.idiomatic: This is roughly where the Sun recently enters and leaves.

sentences.zh: 凡此二事，皆書契所未載也，

translations.literal: These two matters are what written records had not carried.
translations.idiomatic: These two matters are what written records had not carried.

sentences.zh: 太史監南宮說擇河南平地，以水準繩，樹八尺之表而以引度之。

translations.literal: Astronomy Director Nangong Shuo selected level land in Henan, using water-level cord, set an eight-chi gnomon and measured by leading.
translations.idiomatic: Astronomy Director Nangong Shuo selected level land in Henan, using water-level cord, set an eight-chi gnomon and measured by leading.

sentences.zh: 始自滑州白馬縣，北至之晷，尺有五寸七分。

translations.literal: Beginning from Baima County, Huazhou, north to the solstice shadow one chi five cun seven fen.
translations.idiomatic: Beginning from Baima County, Huazhou, north to the solstice shadow one chi five cun seven fen.

sentences.zh: 自滑州臺表南行一百九十八里百七十九步，得汴州浚儀古臺表，夏至影長一尺五寸微強。

translations.literal: From Huazhou's gnomon south two hundred ninety-eight li one hundred seventy-nine bu, obtained Bianzhou Junyi's old gnomon; summer solstice shadow one chi five cun slightly strong.
translations.idiomatic: From Huazhou's gnomon south two hundred ninety-eight li one hundred seventy-nine bu, obtained Bianzhou Junyi's old gnomon; summer solstice shadow one chi five cun slightly strong.

sentences.zh: 又自浚儀而南百六十七里二百八十一步，得許州扶溝縣表，夏至影長一尺四寸四分。

translations.literal: Again from Junyi south one hundred sixty-seven li two hundred eighty-one bu, obtained Xuzhou Fugou County's gnomon; summer solstice shadow one chi four cun four fen.
translations.idiomatic: Again from Junyi south one hundred sixty-seven li two hundred eighty-one bu, obtained Xuzhou Fugou County's gnomon; summer solstice shadow one chi four cun four fen.

sentences.zh: 又自扶溝而南一百六十里百一十步，至豫州上蔡武津表，夏至影長一尺三寸六分半。

translations.literal: Again from Fugou south one hundred sixty li one hundred ten bu, to Yuzhou Shangcai Wujin gnomon; summer solstice shadow one chi three cun six fen half.
translations.idiomatic: Again from Fugou south one hundred sixty li one hundred ten bu, to Yuzhou Shangcai Wujin gnomon; summer solstice shadow one chi three cun six fen half.

sentences.zh: 大率五百二十六里二百七十步，影差二寸有餘。

translations.literal: Generally five hundred twenty-six li two hundred seventy bu, shadow difference two cun odd.
translations.idiomatic: Generally five hundred twenty-six li two hundred seventy bu, shadow difference two cun odd.

sentences.zh: 而先儒以為王畿千里，影移一寸，又乖舛而不同矣。

translations.literal: But earlier scholars thought the royal domain one thousand li, shadow shifts one cun—again erroneous and not the same.
translations.idiomatic: But earlier scholars thought the royal domain one thousand li, shadow shifts one cun—again erroneous and not the same.

sentences.zh: 今以句股圖校之，陽城北至之晷，一尺四寸八分弱；

translations.literal: Now using the gnomon-triangle diagram to verify, Yangcheng north to solstice shadow one chi four cun eight fen weak;
translations.idiomatic: Now using the gnomon-triangle diagram to verify, Yangcheng north to solstice shadow one chi four cun eight fen weak;

sentences.zh: 冬至之晷，一丈二尺七寸一分半；

translations.literal: winter solstice shadow one zhang two chi seven cun one fen half;
translations.idiomatic: winter solstice shadow one zhang two chi seven cun one fen half;

sentences.zh: 春秋分，其長五尺四寸三分。

translations.literal: spring and autumn equinoxes, length five chi four cun three fen.
translations.idiomatic: spring and autumn equinoxes, length five chi four cun three fen.

sentences.zh: 以覆矩斜視，北極出地三十四度四分。

translations.literal: By the covering-square oblique sighting, north pole emerging from earth thirty-four degrees four fen.
translations.idiomatic: By the covering-square oblique sighting, north pole emerging from earth thirty-four degrees four fen.

sentences.zh: 凡度分皆以十分為法。

translations.literal: All degrees and fractions use ten parts as method.
translations.idiomatic: All degrees and fractions use ten parts as method.

sentences.zh: 自滑臺表視之，高三十五度三分。

translations.literal: Viewed from Huatai gnomon, height thirty-five degrees three fen.
translations.idiomatic: Viewed from Huatai gnomon, height thirty-five degrees three fen.

sentences.zh: 差陽城九分。

translations.literal: Difference from Yangcheng nine fen.
translations.idiomatic: Difference from Yangcheng nine fen.

sentences.zh: 自浚儀表視之，高三十四度八分。

translations.literal: Viewed from Junyi gnomon, height thirty-four degrees eight fen.
translations.idiomatic: Viewed from Junyi gnomon, height thirty-four degrees eight fen.

sentences.zh: 差陽城四分。

translations.literal: Difference from Yangcheng four fen.
translations.idiomatic: Difference from Yangcheng four fen.

sentences.zh: 自武津表視之，高三十三度八分。

translations.literal: Viewed from Wujin gnomon, height thirty-three degrees eight fen.
translations.idiomatic: Viewed from Wujin gnomon, height thirty-three degrees eight fen.

sentences.zh: 差陽城九分。

translations.literal: Difference from Yangcheng nine fen.
translations.idiomatic: Difference from Yangcheng nine fen.

sentences.zh: 雖秒分稍有盈縮，雖以目校，然大率五百二十六里二百七十步而北極差一度半，三百五十一里八十步而差一度。

translations.literal: Though seconds and fractions slightly have surplus and deficit, though verified by eye, generally five hundred twenty-six li two hundred seventy bu and north pole differs one and a half degrees; three hundred fifty-one li eighty bu and differs one degree.
translations.idiomatic: Though seconds and fractions slightly have surplus and deficit, though verified by eye, generally five hundred twenty-six li two hundred seventy bu and north pole differs one and a half degrees; three hundred fifty-one li eighty bu and differs one degree.

sentences.zh: 樞極之遠近不同，則黃道之軌景固隨而遷變矣。

translations.literal: The pivot pole's distance near and far being different, then the ecliptic's track and shadow naturally follow and shift.
translations.idiomatic: The pivot pole's distance near and far being different, then the ecliptic's track and shadow naturally follow and shift.

sentences.zh: 自此為率，推之比歲朗州測影，夏至長七寸七分，冬至長一丈五寸三分，春秋分四尺三寸七分半。

translations.literal: From this as rate, extrapolating compared with Langzhou's shadow measurement—summer solstice length seven cun seven fen, winter solstice one zhang five cun three fen, spring and autumn equinoxes four chi three cun seven fen half.
translations.idiomatic: From this as rate, extrapolating compared with Langzhou's shadow measurement—summer solstice length seven cun seven fen, winter solstice one zhang five cun three fen, spring and autumn equinoxes four chi three cun seven fen half.

sentences.zh: 以圖測之，定氣長四尺四寸七分。

translations.literal: Measured by the diagram, fixed qi length four chi four cun seven fen.
translations.idiomatic: Measured by the diagram, fixed qi length four chi four cun seven fen.

sentences.zh: 按圖斜視，北極出地二十九度半。

translations.literal: According to the diagram oblique sighting, north pole emerging from earth twenty-nine degrees half.
translations.idiomatic: According to the diagram oblique sighting, north pole emerging from earth twenty-nine degrees half.

sentences.zh: 差陽城五度二分。

translations.literal: Difference from Yangcheng five degrees two fen.
translations.idiomatic: Difference from Yangcheng five degrees two fen.

sentences.zh: 蔚州橫野軍測影，夏至長二尺二寸九分，冬至長一丈五尺八寸九分，春秋分長六尺四寸四分半。

translations.literal: Weizhou Hengye Army shadow measurement—summer solstice length two chi two cun nine fen, winter solstice one zhang five chi eight cun nine fen, spring and autumn equinoxes six chi four cun four fen half.
translations.idiomatic: Weizhou Hengye Army shadow measurement—summer solstice length two chi two cun nine fen, winter solstice one zhang five chi eight cun nine fen, spring and autumn equinoxes six chi four cun four fen half.

sentences.zh: 以圖測之，定氣六尺六寸三分半。

translations.literal: Measured by the diagram, fixed qi six chi six cun three fen half.
translations.idiomatic: Measured by the diagram, fixed qi six chi six cun three fen half.

sentences.zh: 按圖斜視，北極出地四十度。

translations.literal: According to the diagram oblique sighting, north pole emerging from earth forty degrees.
translations.idiomatic: According to the diagram oblique sighting, north pole emerging from earth forty degrees.

sentences.zh: 差陽城五度二分。

translations.literal: Difference from Yangcheng five degrees two fen.
translations.idiomatic: Difference from Yangcheng five degrees two fen.

sentences.zh: 凡南北之差十度半，其徑三千六百八十里九十步。

translations.literal: Generally north-south difference ten degrees half; its diameter three thousand six hundred eighty li ninety bu.
translations.idiomatic: Generally north-south difference ten degrees half; its diameter three thousand six hundred eighty li ninety bu.

sentences.zh: 自陽城至朗州，一千八百二十六里百九十六步，自陽城至蔚州橫野軍，一千八百六十一里二百一十四步。

translations.literal: From Yangcheng to Langzhou one thousand eight hundred twenty-six li one hundred ninety-six bu; from Yangcheng to Weizhou Hengye Army one thousand eight hundred sixty-one li two hundred fourteen bu.
translations.idiomatic: From Yangcheng to Langzhou one thousand eight hundred twenty-six li one hundred ninety-six bu; from Yangcheng to Weizhou Hengye Army one thousand eight hundred sixty-one li two hundred fourteen bu.

sentences.zh: 北至之晷，差一尺五寸三分，自陽城至朗州，差七寸二分，自陽城至橫野軍，差八寸。

translations.literal: North to solstice shadow difference one chi five cun three fen; from Yangcheng to Langzhou difference seven cun two fen; from Yangcheng to Hengye Army difference eight cun.
translations.idiomatic: North to solstice shadow difference one chi five cun three fen; from Yangcheng to Langzhou difference seven cun two fen; from Yangcheng to Hengye Army difference eight cun.

sentences.zh: 南至之晷，差五尺三寸六分。

translations.literal: South to solstice shadow difference five chi three cun six fen.
translations.idiomatic: South to solstice shadow difference five chi three cun six fen.

sentences.zh: 自陽城至朗州，差二尺一寸八分，自陽城至橫野軍，差三尺一寸八分。

translations.literal: From Yangcheng to Langzhou difference two chi one cun eight fen; from Yangcheng to Hengye Army difference three chi one cun eight fen.
translations.idiomatic: From Yangcheng to Langzhou difference two chi one cun eight fen; from Yangcheng to Hengye Army difference three chi one cun eight fen.

sentences.zh: 率夏至與南方差步，冬至與北方差多。

translations.literal: Rate: summer solstice and south differ in bu; winter solstice and north differ more.
translations.idiomatic: Rate: summer solstice and south differ in bu; winter solstice and north differ more.

sentences.zh: 又以圖校安南，日在天頂北二度四分，北極高二十度四分，冬至影長七尺九寸四分，定春秋分影長二尺九寸三分。

translations.literal: Again using the diagram to verify Annan—the Sun at two degrees four fen north of the celestial apex, north pole height twenty degrees four fen, winter solstice shadow seven chi nine cun four fen, fixed spring and autumn equinox shadow two chi nine cun three fen.
translations.idiomatic: Again using the diagram to verify Annan—the Sun at two degrees four fen north of the celestial apex, north pole height twenty degrees four fen, winter solstice shadow seven chi nine cun four fen, fixed spring and autumn equinox shadow two chi nine cun three fen.

sentences.zh: 差陽城十四度三分，其徑五千二十三里。

translations.literal: Difference from Yangcheng fourteen degrees three fen; its diameter five thousand twenty-three li.
translations.idiomatic: Difference from Yangcheng fourteen degrees three fen; its diameter five thousand twenty-three li.

sentences.zh: 至林邑國，日在天頂北六度六分強，北極之高十七度四分，周圓三十五度，常見不隱。

translations.literal: To the kingdom of Linyi, the Sun at six degrees six fen strong north of the celestial apex, north pole height seventeen degrees four fen, full circuit thirty-five degrees, constantly visible never hidden.
translations.idiomatic: To the kingdom of Linyi, the Sun at six degrees six fen strong north of the celestial apex, north pole height seventeen degrees four fen, full circuit thirty-five degrees, constantly visible never hidden.

sentences.zh: 冬至影長六尺九寸，其徑六千一百一十二里。

translations.literal: Winter solstice shadow six chi nine cun; its diameter six thousand one hundred twelve li.
translations.idiomatic: Winter solstice shadow six chi nine cun; its diameter six thousand one hundred twelve li.

sentences.zh: 假令距陽城而北，至鐵勒之地亦十七度四分，合與林邑與等，則五月日在天頂南二十七度四分，北極之高五十二度，周圓一百四度，常見不隱。

translations.literal: Supposing distance north from Yangcheng to Tiele land also seventeen degrees four fen, combined equal with Linyi—then in the fifth month the Sun at twenty-seven degrees four fen south of the celestial apex, north pole height fifty-two degrees, full circuit one hundred four degrees, constantly visible never hidden.
translations.idiomatic: Supposing distance north from Yangcheng to Tiele land also seventeen degrees four fen, combined equal with Linyi—then in the fifth month the Sun at twenty-seven degrees four fen south of the celestial apex, north pole height fifty-two degrees, full circuit one hundred four degrees, constantly visible never hidden.

sentences.zh: 北至之齕四尺一寸三分，南至之齕二丈九就十寸六分。

translations.literal: North to solstice shadow four chi one cun three fen; south to solstice shadow two zhang nine chi ten cun six fen.
translations.idiomatic: North to solstice shadow four chi one cun three fen; south to solstice shadow two zhang nine chi ten cun six fen.

sentences.zh: 定春秋分影長九尺八寸七分。

translations.literal: Fixed spring and autumn equinox shadow nine chi eight cun seven fen.
translations.idiomatic: Fixed spring and autumn equinox shadow nine chi eight cun seven fen.

sentences.zh: 北方其沒地才十五度餘，昏伏於亥之正西，晨見於醜之正東，以里數推之，已在回紇之北，又南距洛陽九千八百一十里，則五月極長之日，其夕常明，然則骨利幹猶在其南矣。

translations.literal: North there its submerged earth barely fifteen degrees odd; at dusk hiding in hai's due west, at dawn seen in chou's due east—by li number extrapolating, already north of the Uighur; again south nine thousand eight hundred ten li from Luoyang—then at the fifth month pole-longest day, its evening constantly bright; then Guligan is still south of it.
translations.idiomatic: North there its submerged earth barely fifteen degrees odd; at dusk hiding in hai's due west, at dawn seen in chou's due east—by li number extrapolating, already north of the Uighur; again south nine thousand eight hundred ten li from Luoyang—then at the fifth month pole-longest day, its evening constantly bright; then Guligan is still south of it.

sentences.zh: 又先儒以南戴日下萬五千里為句股，斜射陽城為弦，考周徑之率以揆天度，當一千四百六里二十四步有餘。

translations.literal: Also earlier scholars took south bearing the Sun below fifteen thousand li as gnomon-leg, oblique shooting Yangcheng as hypotenuse, examining Zhou-diameter rate to measure heavenly degrees—should be one thousand four hundred six li twenty-four bu odd.
translations.idiomatic: Also earlier scholars took south bearing the Sun below fifteen thousand li as gnomon-leg, oblique shooting Yangcheng as hypotenuse, examining Zhou-diameter rate to measure heavenly degrees—should be one thousand four hundred six li twenty-four bu odd.

sentences.zh: 今測日影，距陽城五千餘里，已居戴日之南，則一度之廣，皆宜三分去二，計南北極相去才八萬餘里，其徑五萬餘里，宇宙之廣，豈若是乎？

translations.literal: Now measuring Sun shadows, distance from Yangcheng five thousand-odd li, already south of bearing the Sun—then one degree's breadth all should three parts remove two; calculating north and south poles mutually distant barely eighty thousand-odd li, its diameter fifty thousand-odd li—is the cosmos's breadth really so?
translations.idiomatic: Now measuring Sun shadows, distance from Yangcheng five thousand-odd li, already south of bearing the Sun—then one degree's breadth all should three parts remove two; calculating north and south poles mutually distant barely eighty thousand-odd li, its diameter fifty thousand-odd li—is the cosmos's breadth really so?

sentences.zh: 然則王蕃所傳，蓋以管窺天，以蠡測海之義也。

translations.literal: Then what Wang Fan transmitted is probably the meaning of viewing heaven through a tube, measuring the sea with a gourd dipper.
translations.idiomatic: Then what Wang Fan transmitted is probably the meaning of viewing heaven through a tube, measuring the sea with a gourd dipper.

sentences.zh: 古人所以恃句股之術，謂其有征於近事。

translations.literal: Men of old therefore relied on gnomon-triangle technique, saying it had verification in near matters.
translations.idiomatic: Men of old therefore relied on gnomon-triangle technique, saying it had verification in near matters.

sentences.zh: 顧未知目視不能遠，浸成微分之差，其差不已，遂與術錯。

translations.literal: But not knowing sight cannot reach far, gradually forming fractional differences; the difference not stopping, then diverging from the method.
translations.idiomatic: But not knowing sight cannot reach far, gradually forming fractional differences; the difference not stopping, then diverging from the method.

sentences.zh: 如人游於大湖，廣不盈百里，而睹日月朝夕出入湖中。

translations.literal: Like a person traveling on a great lake, breadth not filling one hundred li, yet seeing the Sun and Moon morning and evening enter and leave the lake.
translations.idiomatic: Like a person traveling on a great lake, breadth not filling one hundred li, yet seeing the Sun and Moon morning and evening enter and leave the lake.

sentences.zh: 及其浮於巨海，不知幾千萬里，猶睹日月朝出其中，夕入其中。

translations.literal: When floating on the vast sea, not knowing several thousand ten-thousand li, still seeing the Sun and Moon dawn emerging from within, dusk entering within.
translations.idiomatic: When floating on the vast sea, not knowing several thousand ten-thousand li, still seeing the Sun and Moon dawn emerging from within, dusk entering within.

sentences.zh: 若於朝夕之際，俱設重差而望之，必將小大同術而不可分矣。

translations.literal: If at morning and evening's interval both set double-difference and sight, inevitably small and large same method and indivisible.
translations.idiomatic: If at morning and evening's interval both set double-difference and sight, inevitably small and large same method and indivisible.

sentences.zh: 夫橫既有之，縱亦宜然。

translations.literal: Horizontal having it, vertical also should be so.
translations.idiomatic: Horizontal having it, vertical also should be so.

sentences.zh: 假令設兩表，南北相距十里，其崇皆數十里，若置火炬于南表之端，而植八尺之木於其下，則當無影。

translations.literal: Supposing two gnomons set, north and south mutually distant ten li, both heights several tens of li—if setting a torch at the south gnomon's top, and planting an eight-chi pole below it, then there should be no shadow.
translations.idiomatic: Supposing two gnomons set, north and south mutually distant ten li, both heights several tens of li—if setting a torch at the south gnomon's top, and planting an eight-chi pole below it, then there should be no shadow.

sentences.zh: 試從南表之下，仰望北表之端，必將積微分之差，漸與南表參合。

translations.literal: Try from below the south gnomon, looking up at the north gnomon's top—invariably accumulated fractional differences will gradually join with the south gnomon.
translations.idiomatic: Try from below the south gnomon, looking up at the north gnomon's top—invariably accumulated fractional differences will gradually join with the south gnomon.

sentences.zh: 表首參合，則置炬於其上，亦當無影矣。

translations.literal: Gnomon tops joining, then setting a torch on it, also should have no shadow.
translations.idiomatic: Gnomon tops joining, then setting a torch on it, also should have no shadow.

sentences.zh: 又置火炬於北表之端，而植八尺之木於其下，則當無影。

translations.literal: Again setting a torch at the north gnomon's top, and planting an eight-chi pole below it, then there should be no shadow.
translations.idiomatic: Again setting a torch at the north gnomon's top, and planting an eight-chi pole below it, then there should be no shadow.

sentences.zh: 試從北表之下，仰望南表之端，又將積微分之差，漸與北表參合。

translations.literal: Try from below the north gnomon, looking up at the south gnomon's top—again accumulated fractional differences will gradually join with the north gnomon.
translations.idiomatic: Try from below the north gnomon, looking up at the south gnomon's top—again accumulated fractional differences will gradually join with the north gnomon.

sentences.zh: 表首參合，則置炬於其上，亦當無影矣。

translations.literal: Gnomon tops joining, then setting a torch on it, also should have no shadow.
translations.idiomatic: Gnomon tops joining, then setting a torch on it, also should have no shadow.

sentences.zh: 復於二表之間，相距各五里，更植八尺之木，仰而望之，則表首環屈而相會。

translations.literal: Again between the two gnomons, mutually distant each five li, further planting eight-chi poles, looking up and sighting—then gnomon tops curve and meet.
translations.idiomatic: Again between the two gnomons, mutually distant each five li, further planting eight-chi poles, looking up and sighting—then gnomon tops curve and meet.

sentences.zh: 若置火炬於兩表之端，皆當無影。

translations.literal: If setting torches at both gnomons' tops, all should have no shadow.
translations.idiomatic: If setting torches at both gnomons' tops, all should have no shadow.

sentences.zh: 夫數十里之高與十里之廣，然則斜射之影與仰望不殊。

translations.literal: Several tens of li height and ten li breadth—then oblique shooting's shadow and looking up are not different.
translations.idiomatic: Several tens of li height and ten li breadth—then oblique shooting's shadow and looking up are not different.

sentences.zh: 今欲求其影差以推遠近高下，猶尚不可知也；

translations.literal: Now wishing to seek its shadow difference to extrapolate distance near and high and low, still not knowable;
translations.idiomatic: Now wishing to seek its shadow difference to extrapolate distance near and high and low, still not knowable;

sentences.zh: 而況稽周天積裏之數於不測之中，又可必乎！

translations.literal: how much more examining heaven's full-circuit accumulated li within the unmeasurable—again how can it be certain!
translations.idiomatic: how much more examining heaven's full-circuit accumulated li within the unmeasurable—again how can it be certain!

sentences.zh: 假令學者因二十里之高以立句股之術，尚不知其所以然，況八尺之木乎！

translations.literal: Supposing scholars because of twenty li height establish gnomon-triangle method, still not knowing its why—how much more an eight-chi pole!
translations.idiomatic: Supposing scholars because of twenty li height establish gnomon-triangle method, still not knowing its why—how much more an eight-chi pole!

sentences.zh: 原人所以步圭景之意，將欲節宣和氣，輔相物宜，而不在於辰次之周徑；

translations.literal: Tracing why men step the altar-shadow's intent—they wished to moderate and harmonize qi, assist and complement things' suitability, not in the full circuit's diameter;
translations.idiomatic: Tracing why men step the altar-shadow's intent—they wished to moderate and harmonize qi, assist and complement things' suitability, not in the full circuit's diameter;

sentences.zh: 其所以重歷數之意，將欲敬授人時，欽若乾象，而不在於渾、蓋之是非。

translations.literal: why they valued calendric numbers—they wished reverently to grant seasons to the people, reverently accord with the qian image, not in whether armillary or canopy is right or wrong.
translations.idiomatic: why they valued calendric numbers—they wished reverently to grant seasons to the people, reverently accord with the qian image, not in whether armillary or canopy is right or wrong.

sentences.zh: 若乃述無稽之談於視聽之所不及，則君子闕疑而不質，仲尼慎言而不論也。

translations.literal: If narrating unverified talk beyond sight and hearing's reach—then the noble man leaves doubt and does not examine; Confucius is careful in speech and does not discuss.
translations.idiomatic: If narrating unverified talk beyond sight and hearing's reach—then the noble man leaves doubt and does not examine; Confucius is careful in speech and does not discuss.

sentences.zh: 而或者各守所傳之器以述天體，謂渾元可任數而測，大象可運算而窺，終以六家之說，迭為矛盾。

translations.literal: But some each guard the transmitted instrument to narrate the celestial body, saying the armillary origin can bear numbers and measure, the great image can be computed and peeped—ultimately the six schools' sayings iteratively contradict.
translations.idiomatic: But some each guard the transmitted instrument to narrate the celestial body, saying the armillary origin can bear numbers and measure, the great image can be computed and peeped—ultimately the six schools' sayings iteratively contradict.

sentences.zh: 今誠以為蓋天，則南方之度漸狹；

translations.literal: Now truly thinking it canopy heaven, then the south's degrees gradually narrow;
translations.idiomatic: Now truly thinking it canopy heaven, then the south's degrees gradually narrow;

sentences.zh: 以為渾天，則北方之極浸高。

translations.literal: thinking it armillary heaven, then the north's pole gradually rises.
translations.idiomatic: thinking it armillary heaven, then the north's pole gradually rises.

sentences.zh: 此二者，又渾、蓋之家未能有以通其說也。

translations.literal: These two—again armillary and canopy schools have not been able to penetrate their sayings.
translations.idiomatic: These two—again armillary and canopy schools have not been able to penetrate their sayings.

sentences.zh: 由是而觀，則王仲任、葛稚川之徒，區區于異同之辨，何益人倫之化哉！

translations.literal: From this viewing, then Wang Chong, Ge Hong and such, petty in same-different distinction—what benefit to human relations' transformation!
translations.idiomatic: From this viewing, then Wang Chong, Ge Hong and such, petty in same-different distinction—what benefit to human relations' transformation!

sentences.zh: 又凡日晷差，冬夏至不同，南北亦異，而先儒一以里數齊之，喪其事實。

translations.literal: Also generally solar shadow difference—winter and summer solstices not the same, south and north also different; but earlier scholars uniformly used li number to equalize—losing the matter's reality.
translations.idiomatic: Also generally solar shadow difference—winter and summer solstices not the same, south and north also different; but earlier scholars uniformly used li number to equalize—losing the matter's reality.

sentences.zh: 沙門一行因修《大衍圖》，更為《覆矩圖》，自丹穴以暨幽都之地，凡為圖二十四，以考日蝕之分數，知夜漏之短長。

translations.literal: The monk Yixing because of revising the Great Evolution diagram, further made the Covering-Square diagram—from Cinnabar Cavern to Dark Capital's lands, altogether twenty-four diagrams, to examine solar eclipse's fractions, know night clepsydra's short and long.
